changelog: Added Shizuku and root next to ADB: choose how agents reach your phone in Settings → ADB Connect. Agents use adb, Shizuku (rish) or root only when you ask
ADB Connect now reconnects a paired phone by itself when you open it or tap refresh
Fixed Antigravity sign-in: when your Google account isn't allowed, the app now shows why instead of waiting forever
Fixed OpenCode custom providers whose models didn't show up in the model list or in chat (newer OpenCode versions)
Redesigned OpenCode's custom provider editor: full screen, fast with hundreds of models, with search, filters and select all
Added Images, Reasoning and Tools switches for each model of an OpenCode custom provider; "Fetch from endpoint" fills them in from the endpoint, Ollama or models.dev
Added Effort and Thinking controls to OpenCode chats for models that support them, and a warning when you attach an image to a model that can't read images
Added a "Fold after" option for grouped agent steps: how many steps fold into one pill (2 by default)
Agent memory is now on by default; saving chats for agents to look up is now off by default
Added Settings → Updates: get beta updates, and choose how often AntiGem checks for updates in the background
Fixed the app not starting on Android 7 and 8
Back on the main chat screen now moves AntiGem to the background instead of closing it
Fixed a crash on the Claude Code and Codex Plugins pages when the same plugin was installed more than once
Added a Discord community link in Settings → About

Added the page overview: every page (Chat, IDE, Terminal, Browser, Notes, Files) as a card showing how it looked when you left it and what it is doing now. Tap a card to open it, hold and drag to reorder
A tap on the floating switcher's pill now opens the page overview. In Settings → Appearance you can give the overview its own pill instead (the switcher keeps its icon panel) or turn it off
Page overview layouts: Large cards, Fit screen or List, switchable from its header or in Settings
Added size sliders for the floating switcher pill and the overview's pill
Choose the icon of the collapsed floating switcher in Settings → Appearance (it no longer shows an arrow that looked like the chat's jump button)
With the keyboard open, the floating switcher now stays above the chat's input bar instead of covering it
Added a sessions drawer to the terminal, like Termux: swipe right from the left edge to switch, rename or close sessions, show the keyboard, start a new session or open terminal settings
The terminal's floating session pill is now off by default (turn it on in Settings → Terminal). With gesture navigation, choose where on the left edge the drawer swipe works (top, middle or bottom)
The terminal keyboard now shows its toolbar and clipboard. For keyboards that misbehave there, turn on Character-Based Input in Settings → Terminal
Pasting into the terminal from the keyboard is now one quick paste instead of typing every character, and pasted lines aren't run one by one
Swipe the terminal's extra-keys bar sideways for a text box where any keyboard works fully (Bangla/Japanese drafts, suggestions, voice typing)
Renaming a tmux session also renames its tmux window, so the name stays after reconnecting
Fixed words lost when typing in the terminal with phonetic or Japanese keyboards
Fixed Bangla/Hindi marks shown as <09cd> in the terminal's zsh
Fixed the terminal keyboard sometimes not opening on tap (quick double taps, older Android)(added in sidebar of terminal for manual keyboard showing too)
Fixed fast typing getting scrambled in SSH/tmux terminals
Fixed Notes not scrolling to the cursor when you move it with the keyboard's arrow keys (Gboard, Ridmik), and note text no longer hides behind the keyboard
